description: Election Commission - Declare that R. H. R. T. de Silva as a member of the Ambalangoda Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Ambalangoda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by resignation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government elections.
